title: Fix T2 Mac suspend: s2idle, d3cold, and brcmfmac
author: jzimdars
body:
## Summary

Omarchy 4 cannot suspend on a T2 Mac at all, and the sleep state it selects is one these machines do not resume from. Two independent faults, both reproduced on stock 4.0.2:

- **`brcmfmac` blocks suspend outright.** It times out entering D3 (`brcmf_pcie_pm_enter_D3`, `-EIO`). The error propagates out of `pci_pm_suspend` and aborts the transition, so the machine never sleeps — `/sys/power/suspend_stats/success` stays at `0` while `fail` climbs.
- **`mem_sleep_default=deep` does not resume.** Once `brcmfmac` is out of the way the deep state selected by #6562 is actually reached, and the machine never comes back: suspend is entered, the kernel writes nothing further, and it resets. T2 firmware keeps no pstore across that reset, so it leaves no crash log — which is likely why this got through.

A third fault shows up only on longer sleeps: the Apple NVMe controller and the T2 bridges enter d3cold and cannot be brought back out, logging `Unable to change power state from D3hot to D0, device inaccessible` against the controller hosting the root filesystem.

Supersedes #5129, which targeted the v3 layout. That PR also force-unloaded `apple-bce`; measurement below shows that is unnecessary, and it is what produced the `iowrite32` oops a reviewer hit on a MacBookAir8,1.

## Changes

- `fix-t2.sh`: `mem_sleep_default=deep` → `s2idle`. Nothing else in that file changes.
- New leaf `install/hardware/apple/fix-suspend-t2.sh`: pins `SuspendState=freeze` and installs `omarchy-suspend-t2.service`, which disables d3cold on `106b:2005/1801/1802` and unloads `brcmfmac` before sleep, reloading it after. Kept out of `fix-t2.sh` so `fix-brcmfmac-supplicant.sh` remains the sole owner of `/etc/modprobe.d/brcmfmac.conf`.
- Migration `1788315671`: moves installs that 1785944594 put on `deep` back to `s2idle`, and adds the suspend service. Idempotent, T2-only, retries an interrupted boot-image rebuild.

## Measured

MacBookAir9,1, Omarchy quattro 4.0.2-1, `linux-t2` 6.17.7. Each row verified with `/sys/power/suspend_stats` and `CLOCK_BOOTTIME` vs `CLOCK_MONOTONIC` divergence, not wall-clock time — elapsed time alone cannot distinguish "slept and resumed" from "never slept".

| Configuration | Actually slept | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Stock 4.0.2 | 0s | Refused. `brcmfmac` D3 `-5`, `success=0 fail=4` across 2 runs |
| brcmfmac unload + `deep` | — | **Hard reset.** Journal ends at `PM: suspend entry (deep)` |
| brcmfmac unload + `s2idle` | 160s | Resumed, but `nvme 0000:74:00.0: Unable to change power state from D3hot to D0` |
| **+ d3cold disable (this PR)** | **16,236s** | **Clean. `success=2 fail=0`, no NVMe warning** |

Stock refusal:

```
PM: suspend entry (deep)
brcmfmac 0000:73:00.0: brcmf_pcie_pm_enter_D3: Timeout on response for entering D3 substate
brcmfmac 0000:73:00.0: PM: pci_pm_suspend(): brcmf_pcie_pm_enter_D3 [brcmfmac] returns -5
PM: Some devices failed to suspend, or early wake event detected
PM: suspend exit
```

`success=0`, `last_failed_dev=0000:73:00.0`, `last_failed_errno=-5`, device `Broadcom BCM4377b [14e4:4488]` — already enumerated in `fix-brcmfmac-supplicant.sh` for the WPA quirk.

Deep, with brcmfmac already handled — the log simply stops:

```
usbcore: deregistering interface driver brcmfmac
PM: suspend entry (deep)
── nothing further was ever written ──
```

## Test plan

- [x] `bash test/shell.d/t2-hardware-test.sh` — 9 pass, including 3 new cases for the migration
- [x] `bash test/shell` — 225 files, only `config-test.sh`, `snapper-test.sh` and `unowned-system-paths-test.sh` fail, all three identically on unmodified `quattro`
- [x] `bash test/cli`
- [x] `git diff --check`
- [x] 4h30m suspend/resume on hardware, Wi-Fi, keyboard and trackpad all recovered
- [ ] Confirmation on `linux-t2` 7.1.4+ (`t2bce`) — see below

## Caveat

Measured on `linux-t2` 6.17.7, which is the `apple-bce` stack. The fix should be stack-independent: `brcmfmac` and the PCI IDs are identical under `t2bce`, and nothing here touches `apple-bce` or `t2bce` directly — that is precisely what #5129 did and what this drops. But I have not verified it on 7.1.4+, and someone on that kernel should confirm before this lands.

cc @fedesapuppo — this drops the `rmmod -f apple-bce` that oopsed on your 8,1. Worth retesting there: your second failure mode was the s2idle path itself, and if that reproduces without the `apple-bce` handling we have a genuine model split rather than one fix.

Refs #5129, #6562, #6559

@@ -38,6 +38,7 @@ run_logged "$OMARCHY_INSTALL/hardware/framework/qmk-hid.sh"
 run_logged "$OMARCHY_INSTALL/hardware/apple/fix-spi-keyboard.sh"
 run_logged "$OMARCHY_INSTALL/hardware/apple/fix-suspend-nvme.sh"
 run_logged "$OMARCHY_INSTALL/hardware/apple/fix-t2.sh"
+run_logged "$OMARCHY_INSTALL/hardware/apple/fix-suspend-t2.sh"
 run_logged "$OMARCHY_INSTALL/hardware/apple/fix-brcmfmac-supplicant.sh"
 
 run_logged "$OMARCHY_INSTALL/hardware/lenovo/fix-yoga-pro7-bass-speakers.sh"

@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+# Prepare T2 Mac peripherals for suspend.
+#
+# Two devices break suspend on these machines, independently of whether the
+# install runs the apple-bce or the t2bce driver stack:
+#
+#   brcmfmac times out entering D3 (brcmf_pcie_pm_enter_D3, -EIO). The failure
+#   propagates out of pci_pm_suspend and aborts the transition, so the machine
+#   does not sleep at all: /sys/power/suspend_stats/success stays at zero while
+#   fail climbs. Unloading the module before suspend resets the firmware and
+#   removes the callback that fails.
+#
+#   The Apple NVMe controller and the T2 bridges enter d3cold and cannot be
+#   brought back out ("Unable to change power state from D3hot to D0, device
+#   inaccessible" against the controller hosting the root filesystem). Short
+#   sleeps survive it; longer ones do not.
+if lspci -nn | grep "106b:180[12]" >/dev/null; then
+  echo "Detected MacBook with T2 chip. Configuring suspend..."
+
+  # systemd chooses the suspend state itself and only consults
+  # mem_sleep_default when it writes "mem". Pin "freeze" so the choice does not
+  # depend on the kernel command line surviving a boot-config regeneration.
+  mkdir -p /etc/systemd/sleep.conf.d
+  cat > /etc/systemd/sleep.conf.d/t2-suspend.conf <<'EOF'
+[Sleep]
+SuspendState=freeze
+EOF
+
+  cat > /etc/systemd/system/omarchy-suspend-t2.service <<'EOF'
+[Unit]
+Description=Prepare T2 Mac peripherals for suspend
+Before=sleep.target
+StopWhenUnneeded=yes
+
+[Service]
+User=root
+Type=oneshot
+RemainAfterExit=yes
+ExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'for dev in /sys/bus/pci/devices/*/; do vendor=$(cat "$dev/vendor" 2>/dev/null); device=$(cat "$dev/device" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$vendor" == "0x106b" ]] && [[ "$device" == "0x2005" || "$device" == "0x1801" || "$device" == "0x1802" ]]; then echo 0 > "$dev/d3cold_allowed" 2>/dev/null; fi; done; rmmod brcmfmac_wcc 2>/dev/null; rmmod brcmfmac 2>/dev/null; true'
+ExecStop=/bin/bash -c 'modprobe brcmfmac'
+
+[Install]
+WantedBy=sleep.target
+EOF
+
+  systemctl enable omarchy-suspend-t2.service
+fi

@@ -26,10 +26,14 @@ if lspci -nn | grep "106b:180[12]" >/dev/null; then
   echo "MODULES+=(t2bce_vhci usbhid hid_apple hid_generic xhci_pci xhci_hcd)" > \
     /etc/mkinitcpio.conf.d/apple-t2.conf
 
+  # These machines do not return from the deep sleep state: suspend is entered,
+  # the kernel writes nothing further, and the machine resets. T2 firmware keeps
+  # no pstore across that reset, so it leaves no crash log behind. s2idle is the
+  # only suspend state a T2 Mac resumes from.
   mkdir -p /etc/limine-entry-tool.d
   cat > /etc/limine-entry-tool.d/t2-mac.conf <<'EOF'
 # Generated by Omarchy installer for T2 Mac support
-KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]+=" intel_iommu=on iommu=pt pm_async=off mem_sleep_default=deep"
+KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]+=" intel_iommu=on iommu=pt pm_async=off mem_sleep_default=s2idle"
 EOF
 
   # t2fanrd only reads sections for detected fans, so Fan2 is harmless on

@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+echo "Fix T2 Mac suspend: s2idle, d3cold, and brcmfmac"
+
+if ! lspci -nn | grep "106b:180[12]" >/dev/null; then
+  exit 0
+fi
+
+limine_conf="${OMARCHY_T2_LIMINE_CONF:-/etc/limine-entry-tool.d/t2-mac.conf}"
+sleep_conf="${OMARCHY_T2_SLEEP_CONF:-/etc/systemd/sleep.conf.d/t2-suspend.conf}"
+suspend_unit="${OMARCHY_T2_SUSPEND_UNIT:-/etc/systemd/system/omarchy-suspend-t2.service}"
+running_cmdline="${OMARCHY_T2_RUNNING_CMDLINE:-/proc/cmdline}"
+repair_marker="${OMARCHY_T2_S2IDLE_MARKER:-/var/lib/omarchy/migrations/1788315671}"
+needs_limine_rebuild=0
+
+# 1785944594 moved T2 Macs to mem_sleep_default=deep. These machines do not
+# return from deep: suspend is entered, the kernel writes nothing further, and
+# the machine resets without leaving a pstore log. Move them back to s2idle.
+if [[ -f $limine_conf ]] && grep -q 'mem_sleep_default=deep' "$limine_conf"; then
+  sudo sed -i 's/mem_sleep_default=deep/mem_sleep_default=s2idle/' "$limine_conf"
+  needs_limine_rebuild=1
+fi
+
+# systemd only consults mem_sleep_default when it writes "mem", so pin the
+# state directly rather than relying on the command line alone.
+if [[ ! -f $sleep_conf ]] || ! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*SuspendState=freeze[[:space:]]*$' "$sleep_conf"; then
+  sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "$sleep_conf")"
+  sudo tee "$sleep_conf" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
+[Sleep]
+SuspendState=freeze
+EOF
+fi
+
+# brcmfmac times out entering D3 and aborts the suspend outright; the Apple
+# NVMe controller and T2 bridges enter d3cold and cannot be recovered on
+# longer sleeps. Both apply to the apple-bce and t2bce stacks alike.
+if [[ ! -f $suspend_unit ]]; then
+  sudo mkdir -p "$(dirname "$suspend_unit")"
+  sudo tee "$suspend_unit" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
+[Unit]
+Description=Prepare T2 Mac peripherals for suspend
+Before=sleep.target
+StopWhenUnneeded=yes
+
+[Service]
+User=root
+Type=oneshot
+RemainAfterExit=yes
+ExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'for dev in /sys/bus/pci/devices/*/; do vendor=$(cat "$dev/vendor" 2>/dev/null); device=$(cat "$dev/device" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$vendor" == "0x106b" ]] && [[ "$device" == "0x2005" || "$device" == "0x1801" || "$device" == "0x1802" ]]; then echo 0 > "$dev/d3cold_allowed" 2>/dev/null; fi; done; rmmod brcmfmac_wcc 2>/dev/null; rmmod brcmfmac 2>/dev/null; true'
+ExecStop=/bin/bash -c 'modprobe brcmfmac'
+
+[Install]
+WantedBy=sleep.target
+EOF
+  sudo systemctl daemon-reload
+  sudo systemctl enable omarchy-suspend-t2.service
+fi
+
+# The running kernel keeps its old command line until reboot. Record a
+# successful machine-wide rebuild so another user's migration does not repeat
+# it before then, while a missing marker still retries an interrupted rebuild.
+if [[ -f $limine_conf ]] &&
+  [[ ! -e $repair_marker ]] &&
+  grep -q 'mem_sleep_default=s2idle' "$limine_conf" &&
+  { [[ ! -r $running_cmdline ]] ||
+    ! grep -Eq '(^| )mem_sleep_default=s2idle( |$)' "$running_cmdline"; }; then
+  needs_limine_rebuild=1
+fi
+
+if ((needs_limine_rebuild)); then
+  sudo limine-mkinitcpio
+  sudo install -Dm644 /dev/null "$repair_marker"
+fi

@@ -7,9 +7,23 @@ source "$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/base-test.sh"
 fix_t2="$ROOT/install/hardware/apple/fix-t2.sh"
 other_packages="$ROOT/install/omarchy-other.packages"
 migration="$ROOT/migrations/1785944594.sh"
+fix_suspend_t2="$ROOT/install/hardware/apple/fix-suspend-t2.sh"
+hardware_all="$ROOT/install/hardware/all.sh"
 
-grep -Fq 'KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]+=" intel_iommu=on iommu=pt pm_async=off mem_sleep_default=deep"' "$fix_t2" ||
+grep -Fq 'KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]+=" intel_iommu=on iommu=pt pm_async=off mem_sleep_default=s2idle"' "$fix_t2" ||
   fail "T2 setup installs the suspend kernel parameters"
+! grep -Eq '^KERNEL_CMDLINE.*mem_sleep_default=deep' "$fix_t2" ||
+  fail "T2 setup does not select the deep sleep state these machines cannot resume from"
+grep -q 'apple/fix-suspend-t2.sh' "$hardware_all" ||
+  fail "the T2 suspend preparation runs during hardware setup"
+grep -Fq 'SuspendState=freeze' "$fix_suspend_t2" ||
+  fail "T2 suspend setup pins the systemd suspend state"
+grep -Fq 'd3cold_allowed' "$fix_suspend_t2" ||
+  fail "T2 suspend setup disables d3cold on the Apple NVMe and T2 bridge devices"
+grep -Fq 'rmmod brcmfmac' "$fix_suspend_t2" ||
+  fail "T2 suspend setup unloads brcmfmac before suspend"
+grep -Fq 'systemctl enable omarchy-suspend-t2.service' "$fix_suspend_t2" ||
+  fail "T2 suspend setup enables the suspend preparation service"
 ! grep -q 'pcie_ports=compat' "$fix_t2" ||
   fail "T2 setup drops the obsolete PCIe compatibility parameter"
 (( $(grep -Ec '^\[Fan[12]\]$' "$fix_t2") == 2 )) ||
@@ -212,3 +226,71 @@ grep -Fxq 'limine-mkinitcpio' "$calls" ||
   fail "T2 rerun migration rebuilds the boot image"
 [[ -f $repair_marker ]] || fail "T2 rerun migration records the machine-wide repair"
 pass "T2 rerun migration repairs installs the broken hardware check skipped"
+
+# 1785944594 selected mem_sleep_default=deep, which T2 Macs enter and never
+# return from. 1788315671 moves those installs back to s2idle and adds the
+# d3cold and brcmfmac handling that suspend needs on either driver stack.
+s2idle_migration="$ROOT/migrations/1788315671.sh"
+s2idle_limine="$test_tmp/t2-mac-s2idle.conf"
+s2idle_sleep="$test_tmp/sleep.conf.d/t2-suspend.conf"
+s2idle_unit="$test_tmp/system/omarchy-suspend-t2.service"
+s2idle_marker="$test_tmp/t2-s2idle-complete"
+s2idle_cmdline="$test_tmp/cmdline-deep"
+
+cat >"$s2idle_limine" <<'EOF'
+# Generated by Omarchy installer for T2 Mac support
+KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]+=" intel_iommu=on iommu=pt pm_async=off mem_sleep_default=deep"
+EOF
+echo 'quiet splash pm_async=off mem_sleep_default=deep' >"$s2idle_cmdline"
+: >"$calls"
+
+run_s2idle_migration() {
+  PATH="$stub_bin:$PATH" \
+    TEST_LOG="$calls" \
+    T2_HARDWARE="${1:-1}" \
+    OMARCHY_T2_LIMINE_CONF="$s2idle_limine" \
+    OMARCHY_T2_SLEEP_CONF="$s2idle_sleep" \
+    OMARCHY_T2_SUSPEND_UNIT="$s2idle_unit" \
+    OMARCHY_T2_RUNNING_CMDLINE="$s2idle_cmdline" \
+    OMARCHY_T2_S2IDLE_MARKER="$s2idle_marker" \
+    bash -euo pipefail "$s2idle_migration" >/dev/null
+}
+
+run_s2idle_migration 1
+
+grep -Fq 'mem_sleep_default=s2idle' "$s2idle_limine" ||
+  fail "T2 s2idle migration moves the install off deep"
+! grep -q 'mem_sleep_default=deep' "$s2idle_limine" ||
+  fail "T2 s2idle migration leaves no deep parameter behind"
+grep -Fq 'SuspendState=freeze' "$s2idle_sleep" ||
+  fail "T2 s2idle migration pins the systemd suspend state"
+grep -Fq 'd3cold_allowed' "$s2idle_unit" ||
+  fail "T2 s2idle migration installs the d3cold handling"
+grep -Fq 'rmmod brcmfmac' "$s2idle_unit" ||
+  fail "T2 s2idle migration installs the brcmfmac handling"
+grep -Fq $'systemctl\tenable\tomarchy-suspend-t2.service' "$calls" ||
+  fail "T2 s2idle migration enables the suspend preparation service"
+grep -Fxq 'limine-mkinitcpio' "$calls" ||
+  fail "T2 s2idle migration rebuilds the boot image"
+[[ -f $s2idle_marker ]] || fail "T2 s2idle migration records the machine-wide repair"
+pass "T2 s2idle migration repairs installs left on deep"
+
+: >"$calls"
+run_s2idle_migration 1
+
+[[ ! -s $calls ]] || fail "an already repaired T2 install is left unchanged" "$(cat "$calls")"
+pass "T2 s2idle migration is machine-idempotent before reboot"
+
+cat >"$s2idle_limine" <<'EOF'
+KERNEL_CMDLINE[default]+=" intel_iommu=on iommu=pt pm_async=off mem_sleep_default=deep"
+EOF
+rm -rf "$test_tmp/sleep.conf.d" "$test_tmp/system" "$s2idle_marker"
+: >"$calls"
+run_s2idle_migration 0
+
+grep -q 'mem_sleep_default=deep' "$s2idle_limine" ||
+  fail "non-T2 Limine configuration is unchanged by the s2idle migration"
+[[ ! -e $s2idle_sleep ]] || fail "non-T2 systems get no suspend state override"
+[[ ! -e $s2idle_unit ]] || fail "non-T2 systems get no suspend preparation service"
+[[ ! -s $calls ]] || fail "non-T2 systems skip the s2idle repair" "$(cat "$calls")"
+pass "T2 s2idle migration skips unrelated hardware"

comments.body: I have a machine I can fresh install on and test. I await any special testing instructions; otherwise I'll just fresh-install and run this migration script and report back.

> I have a machine I can fresh install on and test. I await any special testing instructions; otherwise I'll just fresh-install and run this migration script and report back.

Thanks! FWIW, I had the agent write scripts to trigger suspend, wait for wake, and then check the logs to confirm success or fail.

This is the `t2bce` / `linux-t2` 7.1.4+ confirmation from the caveat. Same model as the measurements here, current Quattro stack, overnight lid-close rather than a scripted RTC wake.

**Machine**

- MacBookAir9,1 (Ice Lake)
- Omarchy 4.0.2-1
- `linux-t2` `7.1.8-arch1-Watanare-T2-3-t2`
- Stack: `t2bce_core` / `t2bce_vhci` / `t2bce_audio` (no `apple_bce`)
- Wi-Fi: BCM4377b `14e4:4488` at `73:00.0` (`brcmfmac` + `brcmfmac_wcc`)
- `/sys/power/mem_sleep`: `s2idle [deep]`
- `/sys/power/pm_async`: `0`
- Cmdline already has `pm_async=off mem_sleep_default=deep` (current T2 installer)

**What I installed**

Only a `Before=sleep.target` oneshot that unloads `brcmfmac_wcc` + `brcmfmac` on `pre` and reloads them on `post`. Left `mem_sleep_default=deep` alone. Did **not** pin `SuspendState=freeze`, did **not** disable d3cold on NVMe / T2 bridges, did **not** cycle `t2bce` / Bluetooth / audio.

**This boot** (started 2026-09-02 21:22)

| | |
|---|---|
| `/sys/power/suspend_stats/success` | **7** |
| `fail` | **0** |
| `last_failed_dev` / `last_failed_errno` | empty / 0 |
| `brcmf_pcie_pm_enter_D3` this boot | **0** |
| `Unable to change power state from D3hot to D0` | **0** |

Seven `PM: suspend entry (deep)` → `ACPI: PM: Waking up from system sleep state S3` cycles, including a **~4h 37m** overnight (21:31 → 02:08) and a later ~2h 27m sleep. On resume: `t2bce_*` stateful resume status=0, keyboard/trackpad re-enumerated on `t2bce_vhci`, `Firmware: BCM4377/4 … FWID 01-52f5532e`. Lid closed: dark, cool, fan off. Battery drain is overnight-percent, not the old ~10 W “awake with the lid shut” loop.

Representative resume:

```text
PM: suspend entry (deep)
ACPI: PM: Preparing to enter system sleep state S3
ACPI: PM: Waking up from system sleep state S3
t2bce_core: resume: exit status=0 path=stateful
t2bce_vhci: stateful resume exit status=0
t2bce_audio: resume deferred path complete
usbcore: registered new interface driver brcmfmac
Firmware: BCM4377/4 … FWID 01-52f5532e
```

**My ask for this PR**

Unloading `brcmfmac` around sleep is the right fix for `14e4:4488`. Please **do not force `s2idle` / `SuspendState=freeze` on current `t2bce` installs** as part of landing it.

On this Air, `deep` *does* resume once Wi-Fi is out of the way. Forcing freeze would take a working S3 path (fan actually powers off, real ACPI sleep) and put it on the high-drain s2idle path that #6562 / current `fix-t2.sh` already moved away from.

The hard-reset you saw on unload + `deep` looks like an **`apple-bce` / 6.17.7** failure, not a MacBookAir9,1 failure. Suggested split:

| Stack | Sleep state | Wi-Fi |
|---|---|---|
| `t2bce` + `pm_async=off` (current Quattro) | keep `mem_sleep_default=deep` | unload `brcmfmac` only if PCI `14e4:4488` |
| legacy `apple-bce` (your 6.17.7 measurements) | `s2idle` may still be required | same Wi-Fi rule |

Do **not** unload `brcmfmac` on BCM4364 (`14e4:4464`) — that chip wants the driver left bound.

d3cold-disable may still be needed on `apple-bce`; I did not need it for a 4.5h S3 on `t2bce`. Happy to run a longer sleep or a specific test script if useful.

Same Wi-Fi-only `t2bce` result was already reported on a MacBookPro15,4 in https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/discussions/4695 so this is the matching Air 9,1 overnight.
